title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Hiring Spanish Language Translators and Linguist for LLM Annotation Work
description:

DeepLLMData specializes in providing high-quality annotated data for advanced machine learning models. Through our skilled workforce, we partner with clients to deliver precise and impactful data solutions.

This is a remote, contract-based position for skilled Spanish Translators and Linguists for large language model (LLM) annotation work. This role is task based and on contract basis. The role may also involve developing linguistic guidelines and maintaining data quality throughout the annotation process or working on Text to Speech as well.

description:

The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.

description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.

  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

Experiência com plataformas de cursos online.

100% remoto

title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.



Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Modelo remoto prioritário
  • Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
  • R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
  • 30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
  • Day off no aniversário
  • TotalPass (incluindo TotalMind)
  • Acesso ao Wework
  • Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

description:

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
International Countertop Consultants (ICC) is growing! We are currently looking to hire a detail-oriented and organized Assistant Project Manager. The Assistant Project Manager will work with our Project Manager on the planning, coordination, and completion of projects.

A little about ICC: 

ICC is a dynamic and rapidly growing company that specializes in providing competitive commercial granite and quartz countertop and cabinet solutions, including both supply and installation, for multi-family projects across the United States.


While we currently operate with a lean and highly dedicated team, this is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing organization poised for exponential expansion over the next few years. We're looking for someone who’s excited to grow alongside us.


With over 25 years of global industry experience, ICC has built strong international relationships and successfully completed installations in more than 265,000 units nationwide. Our CEO is a founding member of the Rockhead Group, a national alliance of top fabricators representing approximately $1.4 billion in combined annual sales.


At ICC, our culture is the foundation of everything we do. We’re driven by a shared set of core values that shape how we work and who we hire. We believe in authenticity and integrity, always leading with honesty and trust. Innovation and continuous improvement keep us moving forward, while global collaboration allows us to build strong, diverse partnerships. We approach challenges with tenacity and grit, take pride in delivering excellence, and always keep our customers at the center of our decisions. Above all, we value critical thinking and creative problem-solving, empowering our team to ask the right questions and drive meaningful results. These values guide how we build our team, and they’re the standard by which we hire, recognize, and grow.

Job Description:

  • Support the PM with the coordination of multiple projects to ensure they are completed on time and on budget
  • Assist with completing RFI’s, Change Orders, Punch List/Post Walks, AIA/Billing, Close Out Docs
  • Organize and document project tasks and schedules
  • Communicate project status to stakeholders and key project participants
  • Responsible for overseeing, management and administration of our PM software Procore
  • Coordinate Weekly Reporting to Contractors
  • Maintain Project Specific Insurance, Worker’s Comp, Safety Documents
  • Create presentations and reports to communicate project status
  • Draft Subcontractor Subcontracts

Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Strong construction background (countertops/cabinets preferred)
  • Previous APM or similar role experience

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.

  • Local : Remoto

  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.

  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Analista de projetos
description:
Analista de Projetos

Híbrido com preferência para Brasília ou São Paulo ou Florianópolis


Sobre a Fenasbac:

A Federação Nacional de Associações dos Servidores do Banco Central é uma entidade sem fins lucrativos que atua como parceira estratégica do Banco Central do Brasil e CVM, promovendo inovação, desenvolvimento e formação profissional no sistema financeiro nacional. Com iniciativas que vão desde laboratórios de inovação, programas de aceleração de startups até projetos de educação corporativa e consultoria direcionada, a Fenasbac busca impulsionar a transformação do setor financeiro e do setor público, sempre focada em gerar impacto positivo e valor sustentável para seus parceiros e a sociedade.


Sobre as funções:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Projetos com forte visão estratégica, capaz de organizar, planejar, analisar, executar e acompanhar projetos. Esperamos que você tenha experiência com abordagens de design thinking, acompanhamento e gestão de processos e resultados, assim como qualidade nas entregas. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, fornecedores e clientes, além de participar ativamente em revisões e melhorias contínuas.


A pessoa analista responde à Coordenação de Consultoria e Gestão e deverá ter disponibilidade para viagens, se necessário, a fim de acompanhar presencialmente momentos específicos de projetos.


O que você fará:


  • Levantamento e análise de demandas:


  • Apoiar o time de Parcerias Estratégicas e Negócios no diagnóstico das demandas dos clientes;
  • Apoiar na identificação de tendências, benchmarking e análise de cenários para fundamentar o escopo e as propostas;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de diagnósticos organizacionais e estudos preliminares;
  • Analisar os dados, documentos e as informações dos projetos para identificar e propor soluções, considerando o escopo, os prazos e o orçamento.


2. Planejamento de projetos de inovação:


  • Elaborar escopo, cronogramas e planos de ação para cada etapa do projeto, com foco em inovação, definindo os entregáveis, propondo prazos e agendas, em colaboração com os consultores, clientes e fornecedores;
  • Aplicar metodologias ágeis e/ou híbridas na estruturação dos projetos;
  • Elaborar, juntamente com os consultores, e validar jornadas de cliente, incluindo desenhos de experiências, capacitações e workshops temáticos;
  • Identificar e mitigar os possíveis riscos, registrando e comunicando para a pessoa consultora e/ ou Gerente do Projeto para posterior alinhamento com o cliente.


3. Execução e acompanhamento:


  • Monitorar o andamento das tarefas e entregas, garantindo o cumprimento do escopo, do orçamento, dos prazos e a qualidade das entregas;
  • Controlar indicadores, consolidando informações para monitoramento das entregas e dos resultados;
  • Apoiar a equipe técnica na coordenação/realização das atividades de prototipação e/ou implementação de soluções;
  • Organizar workshops, sprints, testes de validação e demais atividades que suportem à execução do projeto;
  • Construir materiais de apoio (guias, frameworks, relatórios visuais, apresentações) apoiando os consultores e alinhando com a área de Marketing as demandas necessárias.


4. Gestão das partes envolvidas:


  • Estabelecer e fortalecer relações com os fornecedores, consultores, clientes (internos e externos) e parceiros;
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre os consultores e clientes para que não ocorram falhas e mal entendidos;
  • Realizar follow up com os consultores e clientes para acompanhamento das entregas e dos prazos, garantindo o cumprimento do cronograma. 


5. Análise de dados e resultados:


  • Redigir relatórios técnicos e gerenciais para apresentação de resultados e descobertas, propondo as melhorias necessárias;
  • Garantir a padronização e a qualidade dos documentos a serem entregues para os clientes.


6. Gestão de conhecimento e aprendizado:


  • Sistematizar aprendizados e boas práticas por meio da elaboração de relatórios, lições aprendidas e cases;
  • Redigir relatórios técnicos e gerenciais, considerando os resultados alcançados, os pontos de melhoria e as lições aprendidas
  • Colaborar com a equipe interna, compartilhando aprendizados e insumos de forma estruturada.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Experiência em gestão de projetos, preferencialmente em consultoria ou inovação;
  • Conhecimento das metodologias de Design Thinking e Design Estratégico;
  • Raciocínio analítico e pensamento estruturado;
  • Habilidade em pesquisa e análise crítica;
  • Capacidade de elaborar e trabalhar com dados, gráficos, planilhas e relatórios;
  • Comunicação clara (verbal e escrita);
  • Relacionamento interpessoal e espírito colaborativo;
  • Capacidade de lidar com contextos complexos e com mais de um projeto simultaneamente;
  • Capacidade para avaliar peças de marketing e comunicação;
  • Fluência em ferramentas de produtividade (Google Workspace, MS Office);
  • Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação, com capacidade para condução de reuniões técnicas ou complexas em inglês);


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência no setor financeiro, consultoria ou cooperativismo de crédito;
  • Conhecimento sobre ecossistemas de startups, consultoria, ciclo de investimentos, governança ou produtos financeiros;
  • Familiaridade com técnicas de facilitação de workshops, como design sprint ou lean inception;
  • Conhecimento básico em inovações tecnológicas como blockchain, cripto/DeFi, IA, Pix, Open Finance e Drex/CBDCs.


Ferramentas que utilizamos:

  • Comunicação e Colaboração: Slack, Discord, Gmail, Teams, WhatsApp, Zoom, Meet
  • Gestão e Organização: Google Workspace, MS Office, Airtable, Miro, Mindmanager
  • Armazenamento: Google Drive, OneDrive, WeTransfer
  • Produção de Conteúdo: Streamyard, YouTube Studio, Mailchimp, Adobe Acrobat, Canva


Remuneração: 

A vaga é para contratação CLT. 

A remuneração exata dependerá da experiência e senioridade da pessoa candidata.

Salário para Analista Pleno: R$5.100

Salário para Analista Sênior: R$6.400


Nossos benefícios:

Vale Refeição (R$ 1.050) 

Vale Alimentação (R$ 450 - após período de experiência)

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica (Especial 100), 

Vale transporte (quando presencial).

Folga de aniversário 

Flexibilidade de horários

Trabalho híbrido (mínimo 1x por semana no escritório)


Próximos passos:

Ao se candidatar, seu currículo será analisado. Caso seja aprovado nesta fase, você será convidado(a) para a etapa de entrevista com a Coordenação da área de Consultoria & Gestão.

A entrevista inicial poderá ser realizada em inglês. Se aprovado, a última etapa será uma entrevista com a diretoria.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.

title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.


The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.


What do you need to know?


  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog
  • Language: Fluent English


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Head of Data Science
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Head of Data Science will be responsible for defining the strategic vision, leading the development, and overseeing the deployment of advanced machine learning models and data-driven products. This senior role will specifically focus on student audience segmentation, predictive propensity modeling, and AI-enabled career advising. The Head of Data Science will manage a team of data scientists and engineers, directing the creation and maintenance of robust, scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions to significantly enhance student engagement, career outcomes, and overall institutional effectiveness.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Science Strategy and Team Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of ML/Data Scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Define the technical roadmap and best practices for all data science initiatives, focusing on model reliability, fairness, and interpretability.
  • Direct the design, development, and implementation of high-impact data products, especially those focused on segmentation and propensity models.
  • Advanced Model and Algorithm Development
  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms for complex student audience analysis and AI-enabled career advising, with a strong focus on predicting student behavior and optimizing engagement strategies.
  • Oversee the utilization of advanced machine learning techniques, including predictive modeling, recommendation systems, and natural language processing.
  • Establish rigorous processes for model evaluation, optimization, and monitoring in production environments.
  • Develop and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines to support all phases of the ML lifecycle.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Communication
  • Serve as the primary technical conduit among executive business leads, product management, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, strategic reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation.
  • Drive the adoption of new data science capabilities and gather feedback for continuous strategic alignment.
  • Release and Change Management
  • Coordinate comprehensive release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for ML model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered effectively.
  • Track and report on post-release issues, adoption metrics, and stabilization progress.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Proven ability to set technical direction, produce high-quality work, manage autonomously, and take strategic initiative.
  • Strong business acumen with unwavering ethics and a willingness to lead by example.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and executive roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements at a strategic level.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing and mentoring a team of data scientists or ML engineers.
  • Expert-level experience building and deploying segmentation and propensity models in a commercial setting.
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
  • Experience with data manipulation and analysis using Python (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, GCS, S3).
  • Proficiency in SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers (e.g., GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab).
  • Deep understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, and A/B testing methodologies.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with media modeling audiences and digital lookalike techniques.
  • Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
  • Knowledge of educational technology or career development domains.


Credentials and Experience:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura no GCP usando Terraform
  • Construir, versionar e otimizar imagens Docker
  • Administrar e operar clusters Kubernetes (GKE)
  • Implementar pipelines CI/CD para aplicações containerizadas
  • Garantir observabilidade e confiabilidade da infraestrutura


O que você precisa ter

  • Inglês avançado para conversação (Será testado);
  • Experiência trabalhando como DevOps;
  • GCP;

description:
Title: Procurement Specialist / Tactical Buyer (Remote)

Location: Brazil

Work Type: 100% Remote

Job Description / Overview

  • You will play a key role in procurement operations, combining procurement knowledge with hands-on experience supporting the External Contract Manufacturing category.
  • This role is primarily administrative/transactional, focused on supply continuity, order processing, and project execution. Commercial negotiations and contracts will be handled by the Category Manager(s).

Qualifications / Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred
  • 2+ years of Tactical Buyer / Procurement experience required
  • Procurement background in direct materials or purchased finished goods is required
  • (Examples: nonwoven products, personal care products, tissue products)

  • invoicing/payment issues
  • supplier communications
  • raw material supply mitigation
  • ERP systems experience required:
  • SAP required

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Project management experience is a plus

title: Project Manager – SAP / Supply Chain
description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager – SAP / Supply Chain to lead and deliver SAP Supply Chain programs and projects in complex, global environments.

This role requires strong experience managing SAP initiatives (ECC and S/4HANA) , coordinating cross‑functional and multicultural teams, and driving end‑to‑end delivery across Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing, and ERP landscapes .


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead SAP Supply Chain projects and programs (ECC and S/4HANA) from initiation to closure.
  • Manage scope, schedule, budget, risks, and quality across multiple workstreams.
  • Coordinate global, cross‑functional teams (IT, business, vendors, and integrators).
  • Drive delivery of SAP initiatives across Supply Chain domains (Logistics, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, Warehousing).
  • Act as main interface between business stakeholders and IT teams .
  • Apply project governance, PMO standards, and delivery methodologies .
  • Support SAP S/4HANA assessments, upgrades, rollouts, and transformations .
  • Manage dependencies across SAP and non‑SAP systems (Oracle, legacy platforms, integrations).
  • Oversee testing phases (SIT, UAT), cutover, go‑live, and hypercare.
  • Ensure executive‑level communication, reporting, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Contribute to portfolio management , roadmap definition, and prioritization.
  • Identify risks, resolve conflicts, and ensure successful outcomes.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Solid experience in IT Project Management , with strong focus on SAP .
  • Proven experience managing SAP Supply Chain projects/programs .
  • Solid understanding of SAP ECC and S/4HANA landscapes.
  • Experience working with global / multi‑country teams .
  • Strong knowledge of project management best practices (waterfall, agile, hybrid).
  • Experience coordinating vendors, system integrators, and offshore teams .
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English (mandatory); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.


Certifications (Required or Preferred)

  • PMP® (mandatory or strong plus)
  • PMI‑ACP®, CSM®, ITIL® (nice to have)
  • SAP project or program management experience highly valued


Nice to Have

  • Experience as SAP Program Manager or Portfolio Lead .
  • Exposure to Supply Chain processes (Logistics, Manufacturing, Planning).
  • Experience with S/4HANA transformation programs .
  • Background in consumer goods, manufacturing, agribusiness, or industrial sectors .
  • PMO setup or governance model implementation experience.


Keywords for ATS

Project Manager, SAP Project Manager, SAP Program Manager, SAP Supply Chain, S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP Logistics, SAP Manufacturing, SAP SCM, Portfolio Management, PMO, PMP, Agile, Global Projects, ERP Transformation

title: Especialista em n8n / Automação Avançada
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.


Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em n8n / Automação Avançada. O profissional irá atuar em ambientes produtivos críticos, com domínio profundo de nós e gatilhos (chunking, retries, desacoplamento de lógica), expressões e manipulação avançada de dados, integrações robustas com APIs REST/GraphQL, LLMs e SaaS corporativos, além de conhecimento sólido em banco de dados e filas do n8n .


Requisitos Obrigatórios - deve ter experiência em:


  • Observabilidade (logs, tracing, alertas);
  • Operação em Kubernetes com workers escaláveis;
  • Versionamento de workflows;
  • Export/import automatizado;
  • Criação de runbooks de recuperação;
  • Biblioteca de sub-workflows reutilizáveis;
  • Aplicação de SDLC/ALM no n8n;
  • Definição e monitoramento de SLI/SLO para filas;
  • Implementação de CRUD de workflows com triggers básicos.


Conhecimentos Adicionais (Diferenciais)


  • JavaScript: Capacidade de criar funções personalizadas dentro do n8n (Code Node) para manipulação complexa de objetos e arrays.
  • Python: Conhecimento para scripts de automação, processamento de dados (Pandas/NumPy) ou integração com modelos de IA.
  • SQL: Noções básicas para consulta e inserção de dados em bancos como PostgreSQL ou MySQL.
  • Ferramentas de IA: Experiência integrando automações com OpenAI (GPT), Anthropic ou modelos locais.


Perfil Desejado


  • Proatividade para buscar soluções documentadas em APIs de terceiros.
  • Organização para documentar os fluxos criados.
  • Foco em escalabilidade (pensar em como o workflow se comporta com 10 ou 10.000 execuções).


Contratação PJ.

Vaga prioritariamente remota, podendo ocorrer visitas eventuais no cliente e/ou escritório da Practia.

title: Engagement Manager (Remote) - Brazil
description:
We are looking for a candidate with experience in Professional Services or customer-facing technical project management roles, preferably within the CRM space (Salesforce, Dynamics, or HubSpot). The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly with clients, gathering and analyzing requirements, and translating business needs into clear application and customer requirements.

The candidate should be able to produce design documentation based on business requirements and collaborate closely with developers to define technical requirements. Experience with programming or coding is strongly preferred, as it enables the candidate to create stronger technical design documents and effectively bridge the gap between business and engineering teams.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Understand the business requirements and processes of customers and translate them to specific functional specifications
  • Facilitating the negotiation of requirements amongst multiple stakeholders
  • Design, manage and conduct client interviews to validate the proposed solutions with requirements
  • Maintain requirements tracking to keep tight control over evolving business requirements and scope changes
  • Become a solution expert who can guide customers on how best to realize value from Magentrix products
  • Facilitating design sessions with the solution architect to define the solution, specifications, and scope.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet delivery and budget targets
  • Coordinate with other Engagement Managers to conduct resource planning and ensure that the project members are utilized effectively.


QUALIFICATIONS


  • University degree in engineering, science or technology field or equivalent
  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an asset
  • Salesforce or other CRM certifications is an asset
  • Experience in preparing solution proposals and detailed functional requirements in consultation with clients and partners


LEAD EXPERIENCE


  • Knowledge of CRM application implementation (Salesforce, Dynamics, or HubSpot)
  • Minimum 3-5 years working as a business analyst/system analyst in a technology setting
  • Able to work under stress and conflicting timelines when necessary
  • Strong interpersonal skills and communicates clearly and concisely (written and verbal)
  • Flexible, energetic, and able to work well with others in a client-focused, innovative and cross-functional environment
  • Proficiency in Google Apps, Project management tools, bug tracking & collaboration tools.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills balanced with common sense and initiative
  • Results-oriented and process-driven, with high expectations of self and team
  • Ability to set expectations with clients and promptly follow through to progress implementations effectively and in a timely manner
  • Ability to effectively receive and communicate feedback

description:
Position Summary:

Our partner is a highly regulated, data-driven technology organization delivering mission-critical background screening and compliance services at enterprise scale, where accuracy and delivery predictability are essential. title: Lead Functional Analyst / Product Owner
description:
Project Description:

  • This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.
  • Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
  • Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
  • The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

  • Product & Backlog Management
  • Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug fixes, improvements, and release work
  • Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance criteria with stakeholder
  • Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
  • Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution
  • Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team
  • Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
  • Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
  • Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery
  • Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination
  • Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests
  • Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or compliance may be affected
  • Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
  • Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
  • Release & Operational Ownership
  • Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

  • Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering
  • Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
  • Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
  • Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for external testers, etc.)
  • Stakeholder Communication
  • Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

  • Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
  • Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
  • Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Product & Delivery Execution
  • Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles
  • Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment
  • Experience managing multiple release timelines
  • Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution
  • Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


  • Quality & Compliance Mindset
  • Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)
  • Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


  • Release & Operational Skills
  • Experience coordinating software releases end to end
  • Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions
  • Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


  • Tools & Ways of Working
  • Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams
  • Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence
  • Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)
  • Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


  • Stakeholder & Pressure Handling
  • Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure
  • Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
  • Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
  • Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: US Immigration Law Firm Paralegal / Brazilian Attorney (Remote)
description:
About Colombo & Hurd, PL


Colombo & Hurd, PL is a nationally recognized boutique immigration law firm dedicated to representing professionals, investors, businesses, and families from across Latin America and around the world. Since our founding in 2006, we’ve grown to a global team of over 350, including more than 30 U.S.-based immigration attorneys.


Named the Top Immigration Law Firm in Central Florida by the Orlando Business Journal, we take pride in our mission to provide exceptional legal representation while advancing the cause of immigrants. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and integrity defines who we are.

We are looking for a licensed attorney in Brazil to join our team, and work closely with U.S.-based attorneys, as well as our paralegals in South America and the U.S., to manage complex U.S. immigration cases. Your expertise will be instrumental in guiding high potential individuals and businesses through the intricate U.S. immigration landscape. A successful candidate will have excellent writing, research and analytical skills to assume responsibility in an active and diverse immigration practice. The applicant must be fully bilingual in both English and Portuguese.


This role requires excellent communication skills both via email and orally. It is exceptionally important that we communicate with our clients in both a timely and effective manner.


Our workforce uses their own devices, ensuring flexibility in how our team operates remotely. A stable internet connection with a speed of over 25 Mbps is required.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Strategic Case Analysis: Dive deep into complex EB-2 National Interest Waiver and EB-1 Immigrant Visa cases, identifying opportunities and potential challenges.
  • Meticulous Legal Research: Conduct in-depth legal research to ensure compliance with U.S. immigration laws and regulations.
  • Persuasive Legal Writing: Craft compelling legal documents, including petitions, briefs, and memorandums, to advocate for your clients' interests.
  • Client Collaboration: Build strong relationships with clients, providing clear and concise information and solicitation of documentation throughout the immigration process.
  • Global Teamwork: Collaborate seamlessly with a diverse team of legal professionals across the globe to achieve optimal outcomes.


Qualifications:


  • Licensed Lawyer in Brazil
  • 3+ years of legal experience (preferred, not required)
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong research and analytical abilities
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • A passion for immigration law and a desire to make a positive impact


Application process:


  • (Colombo & Hurd:) Resume review
  • Request for Brief Video Introduction
  • Interview with Colombo & Hurd Team
  • (Colombo & Hurd:) Offer


Job Type: Fully Remote full-time position - standard business hours.


Join our Dynamic Team:


As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge cases, collaborate with top legal minds, and make a significant impact on the lives of our clients.


We seek professionals who embody our core values of Integrity, Excellence, Teamwork, Hard Work, and Open Communication.


Ready to Make Your Mark?


If you're a motivated and talented attorney seeking a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

title: Vendas
description:

Remuneração: PJ | fixo + comissão + bônus por meta

Ticket médio: R$ 70.000 a R$ 150.000

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos expandindo o time comercial da nossa mentoria premium para médicos empreendedores , focada em crescimento de faturamento e carreira .

Buscamos um(a) Closer High Ticket , com perfil ativo (outbound + inbound quente) , para conduzir conversas consultivas e fechar por ligação e videochamada .

Você atuará com leads vindos de conteúdo, tráfego e indicações e fará também outbound estruturado (cadência) para acelerar conversões. O foco é performance: diagnosticar, conduzir, contornar objeções e fechar com postura consultiva.


Responsabilidades

• Realizar contato ativo (WhatsApp, ligação e videochamada) com leads e oportunidades

• Fazer diagnóstico consultivo (perfil, momento, objetivos, timing e investimento)

• Conduzir calls de apresentação e fechamento com clareza e firmeza

• Negociar, contornar objeções e fechar de forma ética e profissional

• Follow-up estruturado (cadência) até conversão ou descarte qualificado

• Atualizar CRM com qualidade (etapas, próximos passos, motivos de perda)

• Alinhar com Marketing/CS para elevar qualidade do funil e taxa de conversão

• Bater metas semanais e mensais (calls, conversões e receita)


Requisitos (obrigatórios)

• Experiência comprovada com fechamento high ticket por call/vídeo

• Vivência com vendas ativas (cadência + follow-up + condução)

• Comunicação excelente, presença em vídeo e escuta ativa

• Disciplina com pipeline, metas e CRM (HubSpot/Pipedrive/RD Station ou similar)

• Disponibilidade em horário comercial (seg–sex)

• Internet estável, headset e ambiente adequado para calls


Diferenciais

• Experiência vendendo para público exigente (médicos, empresários, executivos)

• Domínio de frameworks (SPIN/GPCT), scripts e playbooks de objeções

• Histórico de metas e previsibilidade de pipeline (CRM bem preenchido)


Perfil comportamental

• Proatividade e ritmo (não espera o lead “pedir para comprar”)

• Maturidade emocional e resiliência (alto ticket exige constância)

• Orientação a resultado com ética e método

• Organizado(a), consistente e extremamente responsável com follow-up

• Aprendizado rápido e melhoria contínua por feedback


Como medimos sucesso (KPIs)

• Nº de ligações e videochamadas por dia/semana

• Taxa de comparecimento (show rate)

• Taxa de conversão por etapa do funil

• Receita fechada/mês

• Tempo médio de fechamento (ciclo de venda)

• Qualidade do CRM e previsibilidade do pipeline


Rotina e ferramentas

• Cadência de contato (WhatsApp + ligação + vídeo)

• CRM + agenda + scripts + playbook de objeções

• Reuniões rápidas de alinhamento e revisão de pipeline


Candidatura

Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e envie na mensagem:

  • Ticket médio que você já vendeu
  • Meta x realizado nos últimos 3 meses
  • Quantas calls/semana você costuma fazer como closer

title: Executivo(a) de Vendas
description:
Junte-se à transformação da saúde no Brasil com a Salux Technology!


A Salux Technology é uma HealthTech 100% brasileira pioneira em soluções inovadoras de gestão de saúde. Desde 1997, nossa missão tem sido democratizar a excelência em saúde, ajudando mais de 250 clientes em todo o país a alcançar resultados excepcionais ao aprimorar a gestão administrativa e clínica.


Em 2021, a Salux passou a fazer parte do Grupo SBPar, o que acelerou nossa jornada de expansão e inovação, consolidando nossa posição como referência em excelência na informatização e soluções tecnológicas para o setor de saúde.


Se você é movido por desafios e quer fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução, venha crescer conosco e impactar positivamente o futuro da saúde no Brasil!

Prospectar ativamente novas contas estratégicas do mercado privado de saúde, alinhadas ao ICP e aos pilares comerciais da Salux.

Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas, desde a abertura da oportunidade até o fechamento e handover para implantação e Sucesso do Cliente.

Atuar de forma consultiva, realizando diagnósticos aprofundados dos desafios assistenciais, operacionais, tecnológicos e financeiros dos clientes.

Desenvolver relacionamento com múltiplos decisores e influenciadores (diretoria, área assistencial, TI, operações e financeiro).

Estruturar e apresentar propostas de valor e business cases, conectando as soluções da Salux aos objetivos estratégicos do cliente.

Liderar negociações comerciais complexas, garantindo equilíbrio entre valor percebido, política comercial e viabilidade do negócio.

Gerenciar um pipeline robusto, previsível e saudável, com disciplina no uso do CRM e qualidade das informações.

Atuar de forma integrada com Marketing, Pré-Vendas, Produtos e Sucesso do Cliente para maximizar conversão, retenção e expansão.

Monitorar mercado, concorrência e tendências do setor privado de saúde, contribuindo para a evolução da estratégia comercial.

Ser guardião do discurso de valor da Salux, assegurando consistência, maturidade e posicionamento institucional em todas as interações comerciais.


Requisitos:

Formação superior em Administração de Empresas, Engenharia (Produção, Gestão, Sistemas ou correlatas), Economia, Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas à tecnologia e saúde.

Experiência em vendas B2B consultivas em saúde.

Vivência com prospecção ativa, ciclos de vendas complexos e ticket médio/alto.

Capacidade de estruturar diagnósticos, propostas de valor e negociações executivas.

Familiaridade com CRM e indicadores comerciais.

Capacidade analítica para leitura de dados e tomada de decisão.

Disponibilidade para viagens quando necessário.


Modalidade de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ).

Modelo de trabalho: Estamos em busca de talentos em todo o Brasil, com disponibilidade para viagens.

Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!


Your role

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll be leading a full stack or backend team focused on one of the key opportunities for Playlist.


You will:

  • Empower your engineering team to deliver a high level of technical quality and business impact.
  • Recruit a diverse team of engineers that are amongst the best in the industry, from outreach to closing.
  • Manage a team of engineers and help develop their careers with stretch responsibilities and excellent feedback.
  • Be actively involved in strategic direction and product decisions for your team.
  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Playlist's engineering management team.


About the right team member

You are an experienced engineer turned successful people leader who is passionate about creating impactful and high-quality web applications. You have deep experience in at least one aspect of developing a world class web application and you can manage a high performing team through the entire process.


You’ll thrive in this role with experience in:

  • 3+ years of directly managing a full stack or backend engineering team of at least 6 people.
  • Experience shipping high quality websites or mobile applications.
  • You have established the architecture and best practices for web or mobile applications and their backends.
  • You have a proven ability to establish and articulate a vision, set goals, develop and execute.

description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.

Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Sobre a BRQ Digital

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!
