  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Automotive Product Owner
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build, test, and deployment processes

• Release engineering or DevOps collaboration experience

• Experience supporting stabilization, bugfix-heavy, or late-stage products

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

• Comfort operating across time zones

• Experience in environments with high expectations and low tolerance for failure


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience in requirements & test case

management in CodeBeamer

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!


Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus


Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

We seek professionals who embody our core values of Integrity, Excellence, Teamwork, Hard Work, and Open Communication.

title: Lead Functional Analyst / Product Owner
description:
Project Description:

  • This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.
  • Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
  • Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
  • The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

  • Product & Backlog Management
  • Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug fixes, improvements, and release work
  • Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance criteria with stakeholder
  • Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
  • Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution
  • Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team
  • Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
  • Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
  • Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery
  • Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination
  • Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests
  • Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or compliance may be affected
  • Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
  • Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
  • Release & Operational Ownership
  • Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

  • Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering
  • Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
  • Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
  • Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for external testers, etc.)
  • Stakeholder Communication
  • Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

  • Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
  • Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
  • Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Product & Delivery Execution
  • Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles
  • Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment
  • Experience managing multiple release timelines
  • Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution
  • Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


  • Quality & Compliance Mindset
  • Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)
  • Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


  • Release & Operational Skills
  • Experience coordinating software releases end to end
  • Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions
  • Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


  • Tools & Ways of Working
  • Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams
  • Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence
  • Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)
  • Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


  • Stakeholder & Pressure Handling
  • Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure
  • Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
  • Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
  • Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $12,000 – $14,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Languages: Fluent English (French is a plus)

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

Start Date: ASAP


We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.


At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.


About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.


Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.


We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.


We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.


What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified


We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French knowledge is a plus (helps with context; fluency not required)
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones


Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability


If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

title: Operador Técnico
description:
Adecco, líder mundial de soluções de RH, está presente em 60 países, com mais de 5.500 filiais em que trabalham mais de 30.000 pessoas, em parceria com mais de 100.000 empresas clientes, distribuídas por todo o mundo. Oferecemos uma ampla variedade de serviços voltados para Recursos Humanos.

Assessoramos empresa multinacional no segmento químico.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Responsável por operar e controlar processos químicos de baixa e média complexidade (ViscoJet, Tanques de misturas, fabricação de polímeros, sistemas de envase, AC401, AC402, reatores de misturas e reações) através de instruções de trabalho garantindo a qualidade, segurança e eficiência da produção;
  • Realizar atividades de baixa complexibilidade (lavagem de utensílios, ensaques, envase, transbordo, paletização, abastecimentos e conferências, seguindo os procedimentos operacionais da área e através do uso de ferramentas e atividades humanas garantindo o atendimento dos cronogramas e planejamentos da companhia;
  • Responsável pela qualidade do produto acabado através dos resultados das análises de amostras do processo; realização de inspeções e seguindo os processos estabelecidos para tal finalidade e recomendando melhorias nos processos para diminuições de custo na produção e aumento de produtividade;
  • Responsável pelos abastecimentos aos demais processos realizando atividades de apoios com auxílio de empilhadeira e operando de forma segura;
  • Responsável por operação de empilhadeira, abastecimento das maquinas dando suporte aos demais operadores, abastecimento e desabastecimento da fábrica de polímeros, abastecimento, desabastecimento e envase das esteiras de envase, operação do sistema de envase via DCS, realização de envases na MPP e EP1 quando necessário, operação de misturas em tachos, container, tambores, etc., no misturador Viscojet, AB306 e demais tanques, realização de limpezas nos tanques auxiliares, tachos, ferramentas e demais áreas, operação e manipulação na fábrica de polímeros com abastecimento/desabastecimento de silos, balanças e sacarias;
  • Responsável por preenchimento de formulários, checklist, relatórios, realização de rondas na área de trabalho, realização de troca de turno inspecionando a área e apontando em checklist e relatório próprio, apontando toda e qualquer não conformidade encontrada e reportando a liderança;
  • Responsável pela qualidade do produto acabado através da execução das instruções de trabalho ou atividades delegadas pelo responsável, no intuito de manter custos de operação baixos, evitando reprovação de produtos e mantendo uma alta produtividade;
  • Operar máquinas de mistura simples na fabricação de óleos e emulsões em containers ou tachos pequenos, operar estação de envase nas plantas de emulsões, e envase dos reatores de óleo silicone, realização de retrabalhos de produtos e reenvase de materiais de uma embalagem para outra;
  • Realizar troca de turno em campo, fazendo a ronda na área operador anterior, inspecionando toda a área de trabalho, anotando as observações em relatórios e checklist próprio para cada posto de trabalho.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino Técnico em Andamento (último semestre) – Química, Polímeros e áreas correlatas;
  • 1 ano de experiência na área ou função similar;
  • Vivência com Empilhadeira é um diferencial;
  • Vivência em qualquer ramo Industrial.


Regime: 2x2 (diurno ou noturno)

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Sênior (PHP E VUE)
description:
A Tech For TI está com oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Stack PHP/Vue Sr , atuar em projeto de cliente AutoTech, focada no mercado B2B, presente em diversos países.


Sobre a Posição:

Buscamos um desenvolvedor Full Stack experiente e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de tecnologia, focado na manutenção e evolução de sistema legado de alta demanda. O profissional ideal deve ter uma mentalidade orientada a soluções e disposição para trabalhar tanto com tecnologias frontend modernas e legadas quanto com diferentes versões do PHP em um ambiente tecnológico heterogêneo.


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

- Backend

Sólida experiência com PHP, incluindo domínio das versões 5.6 e 7.0;

Proficiência em MySQL 5.6, incluindo otimização de queries e performance;

Experiência com Docker e containerização;

Domínio de Git e boas práticas de controle de versão;

Experiência com sistemas de cache, especialmente Redis;

Conhecimento desejável em Google Cloud Platform .


- Frontend

Experiência sólida com Vue.js e seus ecossistemas;

Domínio de JavaScript;

Experiência com jQuery em sistemas legados;

Conhecimento de HTML5 e CSS3;

Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.


Principais atividades:

- Manter e aprimorar sistema legado de alto tráfego;

- Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando Vue.js;

- Realizar a manutenção de códigos legados em jQuery;

- Implementar melhorias de performance e segurança;

- Realizar refatorações estratégicas mantendo a estabilidade do sistema;

- Colaborar na modernização gradual do código frontend e backend;

- Participar ativamente do planejamento técnico;

- Documentar alterações e processos técnicos;

- Mentor técnico para desenvolvedores menos experientes.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência prévia com sistemas de alta demanda;

- Conhecimentos em práticas de CI/CD;

- Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis;

- Experiência em modernização gradual de sistemas legados;

- Conhecimento em arquitetura de software;

- Experiência com testes automatizados (PHPUnit, Jest);

- Conhecimentos em UI/UX e design responsivo.

O candidato ideal deve ser capaz de equilibrar a manutenção de código legado com a implementação gradual de melhorias, tanto no frontend quanto no backend, mantendo sempre a estabilidade do sistema em produção. Valorizamos profissionais que vejam sistemas legados como oportunidades de aprendizado e evolução tecnológica.

title: Tech Lead | Marketplace
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead para evoluir um Marketplace digital de plataforma, com impacto direto na expansão do ecossistema, na geração de valor e na experiência dos clientes.

O desafio envolve evoluir uma plataforma de produtos digitais integrada, escalável e orientada a crescimento. Como Tech Lead, você terá papel central em transformar visão de produto em soluções técnicas sustentáveis e prontas para escala.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução de produtos de plataforma, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance.
  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura, equilibrando integração, autonomia e experiência unificada.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e contribuir hands-on com o time.
  • Trabalhar próximo a produto e stakeholders, apoiando decisões e trade-offs técnicos.
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, promovendo boas práticas e excelência técnica.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência na construção de produtos digitais de plataforma, como marketplaces, portais ou ecossistemas orientados a crescimento (PQL / PLG).
  • Forte base em arquitetura de software e sistemas distribuídos, aplicando Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Vivência sólida em backend distribuído, com microserviços em Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot), APIs REST e contratos OpenAPI.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e comunicação assíncrona, garantindo resiliência e consistência entre serviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL) e modelagem orientada a domínio.
  • Vivência com observabilidade em sistemas distribuídos, incluindo métricas e rastreamento ponta a ponta.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud, com CI/CD, containers e múltiplos ambientes.
  • Conhecimento de frontend moderno, incluindo React e TypeScript.
  • Atuação como Tech Lead, definindo padrões técnicos e orientando times de engenharia.
  • Experiência prévia com marketplaces digitais ou plataformas de monetização.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade avançada, performance e escalabilidade
  • Atuação em produtos com integrações complexas e múltiplos domínios de negócio.


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT

Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Company Description

Empregos.com.br is one of Brazil's premier job and career platforms, connecting professionals with employment opportunities and providing career guidance and training. With over 180,000 job offers from 80,000 companies and a database of more than 1 million resumes, the platform serves as a key resource for job seekers and employers. The service is free for companies to post job openings or search for candidates, aiding in creating meaningful connections in the job market. Empregos.com.br is committed to bridging the gap between talent and opportunity in Brazil.


Role Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level or Senior Frontend Developer to work directly on building and evolving our digital products.


What you will do on a daily basis:

Develop and enhance frontend applications using Vue.js and Nuxt.js

Work with SSR (Server-Side Rendering), technical SEO, and web performance

Consume and integrate REST APIs

Continuously improve Core Web Vitals and search engine indexation

Participate in technical decisions and frontend architecture evolution

Work in agile cycles, with frequent deliveries and constant feedback

Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams to deliver high-impact solutions


What we expect from you:

Solid experience with Vue.js and/or Nuxt.js

SEO is not a plus — it’s mandatory (rendering, indexing, performance)

Experience consuming Web APIs

Experience with CI/CD pipelines

Experience with Docker containers

Strong knowledge of Git

Ability to translate design into pixel-perfect, high-performance interfaces

Agile mindset: prioritization, short delivery cycles, and continuous improvement


Nice to have:


Experience working on high-traffic projects

Strong knowledge of frontend performance optimization

Previous experience with SEO-driven products


What we offer:


100% remote work

Technical autonomy and space for decision-making

A product with real impact and scale

A collaborative environment where we learn and grow together

Contractor agreement (PJ)


If you enjoy solving real problems, working at scale, optimizing SEO and performance, and growing alongside a living product, this opportunity is for you!

description:
LEIA ANTES DE CANDIDATAR

Candidaturas que não sigam os passos conforme a sessão Como se candidatar serão descartadas automaticamente.

As instruções estão no final do descritivo da vaga.


A Hiwis é uma empresa focada em BI, automação, desenvolvimento de sistemas e inteligência artificial aplicada a negócios reais. Aqui a gente resolve problema de verdade: integra dados, cria automações, monta assistentes inteligentes, painéis, fluxos complexos e sistemas inteiros do zero.

Agora estamos abrindo uma vaga para quem quer aprender rápido, trabalhar perto de IA na prática e participar de projetos grandes.


O que você vai fazer

  • Criar automações e integrações (API, webhooks, n8n, scripts Python/JS).
  • Desenvolver assistentes de IA (OpenAI, agentes, visão, fluxos autônomos).
  • Ajudar no desenvolvimento de sistemas internos e dos clientes (front + backend básico).
  • Mapear processos e transformá-los em soluções automatizadas.
  • Auxiliar na criação de dashboards, ETLs simples e organização de dados.
  • Testar, documentar e melhorar fluxos e aplicações já existentes.

Tecnologias e ferramentas que usamos

Não precisa saber todas — mas precisa ter vontade real de aprender rápido.

  • Python e JavaScript
  • n8n
  • APIs REST
  • OpenAI API, Assistants, Vision, Whisper
  • GitHub
  • Power BI / SQL básico (diferencial)
  • HTML / CSS / JS (para sistemas leves e páginas internas)
  • Render

Requisitos

  • Estar cursando Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Eng. de Software ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Ter noção básica de lógica de programação.
  • Gostar de mexer, testar, errar e resolver — zero espaço para quem é passivo.
  • Autonomia para pesquisar, aprender sozinho e ir atrás de solução.

title: Strategic Operations Project Coordinator
description:
Strategic Operations Project Coordinator


We are currently hiring for a division which focuses on providing services to immigration law firms across the United States.


The Strategic Operations Project Coordinator will serve as a key support resource to operational leadership, combining elements of project coordination, business analysis, and administrative management. This role is responsible for managing small-to-medium projects, conducting research and analysis, building documentation, performing system testing, and offloading administrative tasks from senior leaders to improve organizational efficiency. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in AI tools and demonstrate strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities

-Project Management

  • Manage and coordinate small-to-medium projects from initiation through completion.
  • Develop project timelines, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are met on schedule.
  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and communicate project status to leadership.
  • Identify and escalate project risks or blockers appropriately.


-Operational Support

  • Offload administrative and analytical tasks from operational leaders including report generation, data compilation, and meeting preparation.
  • Conduct research on industry trends, competitive intelligence, process improvements, and business opportunities.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations, briefing materials, and strategic documents.
  • Support special initiatives and ad-hoc requests from leadership.


-Analysis and Reporting

  • Perform light data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain operational reports and dashboards for leadership review.
  • Analyze business processes and recommend efficiency improvements.
  • Synthesize complex information into clear, actionable summaries.


-Documentation and System Testing

  • Build and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials.
  • Conduct system testing for new features, integrations, or process changes.
  • Document test results, identify issues, and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
  • Ensure documentation is accurate, current, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders.

  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, etc.) to enhance productivity and output quality.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI capabilities to operational challenges.
  • Stay current on AI tool developments and best practices.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) in professional contexts
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify insights
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to take initiative

  • Familiarity with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.)
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience with SharePoint, Power Automate, or other Microsoft 365 automation tools
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM) or similar credentials

description:
Se inscreva já :


O time de Operações da Shopee cuida de todo o processo de operação, desde a busca do comprador por um produto na plataforma da Shopee até o momento em que o comprador recebe o produto. O time analisa e monitora KPIs operacionais através da região e conduz análises de causa quando a performance das operações flutua. O time de Operações é composto de Atendimento ao Cliente, Pagamentos, Anúncios, Armazém, Logísitca, Operações de Vendedores e Fraudes.


Sobre a Shô

Aqui na Shô, acreditamos que cada membro de nossa equipe é fundamental para o nosso sucesso, e que diversidade de perspectivas e vivências são essenciais para movimentar nosso negócio e impulsionar o nosso propósito de mudar o mundo para melhor.

Fazer parte do nosso time é a oportunidade de se desenvolver dentro de uma cultura de muita agilidade. Se você ama assumir grandes responsabilidades e fazer o que nunca foi feito, a Shô é seu lugar. Aqui você terá grandes desafios, trabalhará em colaboração com um time diverso e contribuirá para o futuro do e-commerce no Brasil, criamos impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

Modelo de Trabalho

Nossos times que atuam nos centros logísticos, trabalham 100% presencial. Assim garantimos a qualidade da nossa logística e também fortalecemos nossa cultura de colaboração e agilidade.

Qual será a sua missão

Responsável por supervisionar a equipe e garantir a eficiência operacional nas frentes de qualidade, treinamentos e retornos. Atua organizando a rotina dos operadores, acompanhando indicadores de performance e promovendo a execução de processos padronizados. Garante os recursos

e capacitações necessários para o bom desempenho do time, conduz ações de melhoria contínua e trata desvios operacionais com foco na causa raiz. Trabalha em conjunto com a liderança para promover estabilidade, engajamento e evolução técnica nas atividades.

Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Supervisionar a equipe e organizar a rotina operacional
  • Garantir a execução dos padrões operacionais e instruções de trabalho
  • Realizar auditorias de processo, produto e housekeeping
  • Acompanhar e tratar desvios, não conformidades e retornos
  • Coordenar treinamentos, reciclagens e controlar a matriz de capacitação
  • Monitorar indicadores de qualidade, treinamento, RR, custo, HC, absenteísmo e turnover
  • Liderar a triagem, classificação e reaproveitamento de itens retornados
  • Identificar causas de falhas e implementar ações corretivas
  • Apoiar programas de desenvolvimento e cultura interna
  • Participar de rotinas de gestão e reuniões de melhoria contínua (Gemba, ABS, Safety)
  • Atualizar conteúdos e garantir recursos para capacitação
  • Criar e acompanhar indicadores integrados por área
  • Conduzir treinamentos práticos e reciclagens com base em desvios e novas demandas
  • Controlar a matriz de treinamentos e monitorar capacitação por colaborador


Requisitos

O que você precisa para assumir o desafio

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office Avançado.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de pessoas e operações logísticas;
  • Ter uma compreensão detalhada do modelo de negócio de operações;
  • Gestão de processos por indicadores, com envolvimento do time e estabelecendo ações de correção;
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas como kaizen, PDCA, 5S;
  • Capacidade analítica para diagnosticar melhorias de processo, negociação e influenciar pessoas.

Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica, estendendo-se aos dependentes;
  • Parceria com Gympass e TotalPass;

  • Vale Transporte, Vale Mobilidade ou Estacionamento no local;

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Você atuará em um cliente do segmento industrial do agronegócio , com um ambiente SAP robusto e foco na evolução tecnológica em SAP S/4HANA . O projeto envolve sistemas críticos para o negócio, com atuação tanto em melhorias evolutivas quanto em sustentação, participando diretamente de iniciativas estratégicas da operação.

  • Atuar em conjunto com analistas funcionais e áreas de negócio

  • Participar de code reviews e iniciativas de melhoria contínua
  • Atuar com suporte técnico Nível 3
  • Acompanhar tendências e novas abordagens no ecossistema SAP

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento ABAP
  • Vivência com SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA
  • Experiência em objetos RICEF
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em ABAP e ABAP OO
  • Experiência com SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37 e Eclipse (ADT)

title: Senior TypeScript Functional Backend Engineer (Integrations) LATAM
description:
Description

We are hiring a Senior Functional Backend Engineer to help us connect to insurance portals across the U.S. to ingest, transform, and deliver structured healthcare data — including claims, EOBs, plan documents, and accumulators.

This role sits at the intersection of production reliability and system design. You’ll own integration health in production, onboard new portals, expand data coverage, and write clean, strongly typed backend code. The team values functional principles - composability, explicit error handling, type safety - and uses Effect extensively, but prior Effect experience is not required.

This is hands-on engineering in a system where correctness and clarity matter.


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient


Responsibilities

Production Triage & Reliability

  • Own first-response triage for portal integration failures
  • Debug login automation issues, crawl failures, and ingestion errors
  • Trace failures across logs, workflows, and monitoring systems
  • Implement clean, durable fixes - not just patches
  • Escalate systemic platform issues when appropriate

Portal Onboarding

  • Bring new insurance portals into production
  • Reverse-engineer APIs and browser workflows
  • Build ingestion pipelines and validate structured outputs
  • Ensure integrations remain resilient as portals evolve

Data Expansion

  • Extend existing integrations to capture new data types
  • Maintain strong typing and predictable transformations
  • Guard against schema drift and data inconsistencies

Collaboration

  • Contribute to runbooks and documentation
  • Participate in async standups and structured handoffs
  • Work closely with a platform-focused engineering team


Requirements

  • 4+ years of Strongly Typed Backend Experience
  • Deep experience in strongly typed languages (TypeScript , Scala, Kotlin, Go, etc.)
  • Careful API modeling and schema validation
  • Comfort designing systems where types act as contracts
  • Functional or Declarative Programming Experience
  • You don’t need to come from a pure Functional Programming background, but you should be comfortable with immutability, explicit handling, declarative composition, and writing predictable, testable code.
  • TypeScript (Backend)
  • Experience building backend services
  • NestJS experience preferred

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Effect (TypeScript Library)
  • If not, you should be comfortable learning it and working within a composable, typed effect system
  • Playwright or browser automation
  • API reverse-engineering via browser devtools
  • Workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar)
  • Data ingestion or transformation pipelines
  • Observability tooling (Datadog or similar)
  • AWS experience

title: Release Product Owner
description:
Before you apply, please get familiar with Luxoft:

Mandatory Skills Description:


  • Product & Delivery Execution
  • Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles
  • Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment
  • Experience managing multiple release timelines
  • Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution
  • Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities
  • Quality & Compliance Mindset
  • Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)
  • Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact
  • Release & Operational Skills
  • Experience coordinating software releases end to end
  • Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions
  • Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)
  • Tools & Ways of Working
  • Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams
  • Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence
  • Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)
  • Ability to operate independently with limited guidance
  • Stakeholder & Pressure Handling
  • Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure
  • Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
  • Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
  • Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Project Description:


  • This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.
  • Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
  • Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
  • The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:


  • Product & Backlog Management
  • Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug
  • fixes, improvements, and release work
  • Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance
  • criteria with stakeholder
  • Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
  • Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation
  • Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution
  • Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team
  • Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
  • Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
  • Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery
  • Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination
  • Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests
  • Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or
  • compliance may be affected
  • Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
  • Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
  • Release & Operational Ownership
  • Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and
  • communication
  • Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering
  • Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
  • Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
  • Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for
  • external testers, etc.)
  • Stakeholder Communication
  • Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or
  • representatives of legal and regulatory departments
  • Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
  • Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
  • Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders

title: Databricks Data Architect
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking a Senior Data Architect to lead the design, governance, and evolution of our enterprise data ecosystem with a primary focus on Databricks . This role establishes data architecture standards, drives platform modernization, and partners with business and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high‑quality data solutions. Experience with other modern data platforms is a plus.


Key Responsibilities


Enterprise Architecture & Data Platform Leadership

  • Design and maintain enterprise data architecture across Lakehouse, Warehouse, and streaming environments.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing modern data platforms in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Extensive experience in designing and maintaining Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
  • Lead solution design and best practices for Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and medallion architecture.
  • Define ingestion, integration, and pipeline standards for batch, streaming, and CDC workloads.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and contribute to long‑term data platform strategy.


Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Development

  • Develop and maintain subject area models, business data models, and dimensional models (fact and dimension tables) and Semantic layer design for BI and AI solutions.
  • Define and document entities, attributes, and business definitions; resolve conflicts in terminology and meaning.
  • Build and maintain enterprise semantic layers to support analytics, BI, and AI use cases.
  • Support standardization of facts, dimensions, and shared business metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to design scalable, cost‑optimized, and reliable data architectures in cloud environments.


Data Governance, Quality & Metadata

  • Ensure strong data governance, security, lineage, and compliance across platforms.
  • Perform data quality assessments and identify appropriate data sources in partnership with Business/Data Analysts.
  • Maintain metadata in the enterprise repository and ensure alignment with governance standards.
  • Assist in developing source‑to‑target mappings and validating data transformations.


Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Conduct user interviews, requirements sessions, and data analysis reviews.
  • Provide architectural oversight and review solution designs across engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers and analysts to ensure consistent adoption of architectural standards.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to align data solutions with business needs.


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in data architecture or data engineering.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Hands‑on expertise with Databricks; building and maintaining medallion architecture.
  • Strong background in data modeling: dimensional, 3NF, and data vault.
  • Proficiency with Spark, SQL, Python, Kafka, Five Tran, APIs, and modern data pipeline frameworks.Knowledge of BI/Analytics/AI tools i.e., Power BI, ML Flow, Sage maker, Etc.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security, lineage, and metadata management.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across engineering, BI, product, and business teams while influencing technical direction.
  • Ability to lead architectural reviews and mentor engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.Ability to influence technical, business, and executive audiences.

Desenvolvedor Full Stack PHP/Vue Sr , atuar em projeto de cliente AutoTech, focada no mercado B2B, presente em diversos países.


  • Modalidade PJ - Contrato Prazo Indeterminado
  • Remoto Full


Sobre a Posição:

Buscamos um desenvolvedor Full Stack experiente e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de tecnologia, focado na manutenção e evolução de sistema legado de alta demanda. O profissional ideal deve ter uma mentalidade orientada a soluções e disposição para trabalhar tanto com tecnologias frontend modernas e legadas quanto com diferentes versões do PHP em um ambiente tecnológico heterogêneo.


Equilibrar a manutenção de código legado com a implementação gradual de melhorias, tanto no frontend quanto no backend, mantendo sempre a estabilidade do sistema em produção. Valorizamos profissionais que vejam sistemas legados como oportunidades de aprendizado e evolução tecnológica.


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

- Backend

Sólida experiência com PHP, incluindo domínio das versões 5.6 e 7.0;

Proficiência em MySQL 5.6, incluindo otimização de queries e performance;

Experiência com Docker e containerização;

Domínio de Git e boas práticas de controle de versão;

Experiência com sistemas de cache, especialmente Redis;

Conhecimento desejável em Google Cloud Platform .


- Frontend

Experiência sólida com Vue.js e seus ecossistemas (Se encontrar com as outras características exceto esta, pode nos enviar mesmo assim);

Domínio de JavaScript;

Experiência com jQuery em sistemas legados;

Conhecimento de HTML5 e CSS3;

Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência prévia com sistemas de alta demanda;

- Conhecimentos em práticas de CI/CD;

- Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis;

- Experiência em modernização gradual de sistemas legados;

- Conhecimento em arquitetura de software;

- Experiência com testes automatizados (PHPUnit, Jest);

- Conhecimentos em UI/UX e design responsivo.

title: Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing)

We are looking for a highly accomplished Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML) with a strong research background and deep expertise in machine learning to develop and deploy advanced pricing and price optimization solutions. This role requires a combination of research excellence and hands-on production experience, translating complex real-world business problems into scalable machine learning systems.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals passionate about applied research, advanced machine learning, and delivering high-impact AI solutions at scale.


Key Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop advanced machine learning and statistical models for pricing and price optimization.
  • Translate complex business problems into mathematical and algorithmic solutions.
  • Analyze large, complex datasets to generate actionable insights and improve pricing strategies.
  • Build, validate, and deploy scalable ML/DL models in production environments.
  • Apply advanced techniques including optimization, forecasting, and causal inference.
  • Develop clean, efficient, and production-grade code.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Contribute to intellectual property through research publications and conference presentations.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentor junior team members.


Required Qualifications (Mandatory)

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • Proven research background with publications in recognized scientific journals
  • Experience presenting research at industry or academic conferences
  • 5+ years of experience in applied Machine Learning
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices including experiment design, A/B testing, feature engineering, and training/serving pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, or Keras
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and data engineering workflows
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure )


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying ML to pricing, optimization, forecasting, recommender systems, personalization, computer vision, fraud detection, or marketing analytics
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and ML lifecycle management
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Demonstrated leadership or mentoring experience

title: Cientista de dados - IA Generativa
description:
Buscamos Cientistas de Dados com foco e atuação em Inteligência Artificial , com experiência ou forte interesse em Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) .


A posição envolve atuar desde a compreensão do problema de negócio até a construção, experimentação e evolução de soluções baseadas em dados e IA, em colaboração próxima com times técnicos, de produto e áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de IA Generativa , utilizando LLMs e abordagens baseadas em RAG.
  • Desenvolver, testar e evoluir pipelines de dados e modelos para casos de uso com IA Generativa.
  • Conduzir experimentações e validações contínuas, avaliando qualidade, relevância e confiabilidade das soluções.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de tecnologia, produto e negócio ao longo de todo o ciclo da solução.
  • Apoiar a integração de modelos em ambientes produtivos, considerando escalabilidade, monitoramento e manutenção.
  • Documentar soluções, decisões técnicas e aprendizados do projeto.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência como Cientista de Dados , atuando em projetos de machine learning e/ou inteligência artificial.
  • Vivência com IA Generativa (GenAI) , incluindo LLMs e arquiteturas RAG .
  • Forte capacidade analítica para exploração, preparação e interpretação de dados.
  • Conhecimento em programação aplicada à análise de dados e modelagem.
  • Experiência em trabalhar com dados em ambientes produtivos e em times multidisciplinares.
  • Boa comunicação para explicar conceitos técnicos a públicos não técnicos.

title: Procurement Associate
description:
Now Hiring | Procurement Associate I (Remote – Brazil)

Location: 100% Remote (Brazil-based candidates only)

Engagement: Contract (Estimated 6 months, possible extension)

Rate: $8-10 USD per hour

Immediate Start Preferred

We are seeking a Procurement Associate I to support procurement operations within the External Contract Manufacturing category . This is a largely administrative/transactional role focused on supply continuity, order processing, and supplier coordination.

This position will cover a maternity leave, so we are looking for someone available to start quickly for proper transition and training.


Key Responsibilities

Purchase Order & Supply Support

  • Troubleshoot PO discrepancies (pricing, delivery delays, quality issues)
  • Resolve invoicing and payment-related issues

Supplier Relationship Management

  • Maintain effective communication with suppliers/vendors

ERP & Systems Management

  • Work within SAP and other ERP systems (Coupa highly preferred)
  • Manage procurement transactions, reporting, and system updates

Project & Operational Support

  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support project timelines


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of Tactical Buyer experience
  • Background in Procurement with:
  • Direct materials OR
  • Purchased finished goods (nonwoven products, personal care, tissue products preferred)
  • ERP experience (SAP required, Coupa highly preferred)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills (supplier-facing role)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred


If you have procurement experience and ERP expertise and are available to start immediately, let’s connect.

Apply now!

title: Project Manager – SAP / Supply Chain
description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager – SAP / Supply Chain to lead and deliver SAP Supply Chain programs and projects in complex, global environments.

This role requires strong experience managing SAP initiatives (ECC and S/4HANA) , coordinating cross‑functional and multicultural teams, and driving end‑to‑end delivery across Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing, and ERP landscapes .


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead SAP Supply Chain projects and programs (ECC and S/4HANA) from initiation to closure.
  • Manage scope, schedule, budget, risks, and quality across multiple workstreams.
  • Coordinate global, cross‑functional teams (IT, business, vendors, and integrators).
  • Drive delivery of SAP initiatives across Supply Chain domains (Logistics, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, Warehousing).
  • Act as main interface between business stakeholders and IT teams .
  • Apply project governance, PMO standards, and delivery methodologies .
  • Support SAP S/4HANA assessments, upgrades, rollouts, and transformations .
  • Manage dependencies across SAP and non‑SAP systems (Oracle, legacy platforms, integrations).
  • Oversee testing phases (SIT, UAT), cutover, go‑live, and hypercare.
  • Ensure executive‑level communication, reporting, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Contribute to portfolio management , roadmap definition, and prioritization.
  • Identify risks, resolve conflicts, and ensure successful outcomes.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Solid experience in IT Project Management , with strong focus on SAP .
  • Proven experience managing SAP Supply Chain projects/programs .
  • Solid understanding of SAP ECC and S/4HANA landscapes.
  • Experience working with global / multi‑country teams .
  • Strong knowledge of project management best practices (waterfall, agile, hybrid).
  • Experience coordinating vendors, system integrators, and offshore teams .
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English (mandatory); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.


Certifications (Required or Preferred)

  • PMP® (mandatory or strong plus)
  • PMI‑ACP®, CSM®, ITIL® (nice to have)
  • SAP project or program management experience highly valued


Nice to Have

  • Experience as SAP Program Manager or Portfolio Lead .
  • Exposure to Supply Chain processes (Logistics, Manufacturing, Planning).
  • Experience with S/4HANA transformation programs .
  • Background in consumer goods, manufacturing, agribusiness, or industrial sectors .
  • PMO setup or governance model implementation experience.


Keywords for ATS

Project Manager, SAP Project Manager, SAP Program Manager, SAP Supply Chain, S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP Logistics, SAP Manufacturing, SAP SCM, Portfolio Management, PMO, PMP, Agile, Global Projects, ERP Transformation

title: UX Research Analyst
description:
This role is 100% remote. Candidates must be able to work cross-over hours with the US. Candidates MUST also be fluent in English.


Pulse Labs is empowering insights and elevating experiences for the world's top technology companies. Backed by investors including Google and Amazon, we're revolutionizing product development delivering human-centered, actionable insights at every stage of the product lifecycle from inception to market release and beyond. We empower top tech companies to create and refine paradigm-shifting mobile, smart home, and AI products.


If you thrive in a fast-paced multi-project environment and love analyzing qualitative data, then you're a perfect fit. You'll work directly with our researchers to execute qualitative research projects such as diary studies, focus groups, IDIs, longitudinal panel studies, etc.


You will be a team-player who is an integral member of a talented and dedicated group of researchers working in a fast-paced, rapid-response environment where rigor and quality are paramount. Using Pulse Labs' proprietary tools and platforms, you’ll dive deep into rich video and survey data to analyze and interpret users’ interactions with and perceptions about next-gen products.


Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with UX researchers to understand research projects, including customer requirements, timelines, analysis plan, and business goals.
  • Assist project team members with the logistical operations of the research program, such as maintaining research timelines, project schedules, question banks, data repositories, and other research-related artifacts.
  • Work closely with the operations team to make sure collected data matches the study requirements.
  • Ensure sound research methods while assisting with initial project plans, analyses, and creating final reports for clients.
  • Analyze responses from participant videos and transcripts, surveys, and other study data to develop key research findings and recommendations for clients.
  • Under the guidance of UX researchers, create deliverables for clients including scorecards, toplines, reports, and slide decks.
  • Develop high quality data visualizations, communicating data and findings cleanly, effectively, and efficiently.
  • Collaborate with the team and across the company to improve our internal processes.
  • Provide feedback to the Design and Engineering teams about how to improve our proprietary platform.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in psychology, research methods, survey methodology, human computer interaction, sociology, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience working as an analyst in a research setting or in a detail-oriented operations environment.
  • Knowledge of the end-to-end research lifecycle, including research methods/approaches and common analyses, specifically those related to UX.
  • Expertise with data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
  • Experience working on a team of researchers as well as alongside operations personnel in a rapid-response, often ambiguous environment.
  • Ability to recognize patterns and anomalies in qualitative and/or quantitative data.

title: Administrador de Servidor Freelance / Administrador Web
description:
Estamos buscando um Administrador de Servidor Freelance / Administrador Web experiente e detalhista para gerenciar e manter nossos servidores de hospedagem web Linux e Windows. Essa função é crucial para garantir a confiabilidade, o desempenho e a segurança de nossos serviços de hospedagem web. O candidato ideal terá uma sólida experiência em manutenção de servidores, solução de problemas e tarefas gerais de gerenciamento de servidores, com flexibilidade para estar de plantão à noite e nos fins de semana.


*Responsabilidades:*


- Executar manutenção regular, atualizações e patches em servidores Linux e Windows.

- Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas relacionados a serviços de hospedagem web, incluindo desempenho de site, e-mail e funcionalidade de banco de dados.

- Monitorar o desempenho, o tempo de atividade e a segurança do servidor, implementando medidas preventivas para minimizar o tempo de inatividade.

- Configurar e manter ambientes de hospedagem web, incluindo cPanel, Plesk ou painéis de controle semelhantes.

- Diagnosticar e mitigar vulnerabilidades de segurança, garantindo que os servidores sigam as melhores práticas de segurança de hospedagem web.

- Gerenciar configurações de DNS e solucionar problemas relacionados a domínios.

- Colaborar com equipes internas ou clientes para atender a solicitações ou incidentes relacionados à hospedagem.

- Criar e manter documentação para configurações de servidor, processos e procedimentos de solução de problemas.

- Estar disponível para plantões noturnos e de fim de semana para responder prontamente a problemas críticos de servidor ou hospedagem.

- Possibilidade de conversar com o cliente diretamente


*Requisitos:*


  • Experiência comprovada em administração de servidores e gerenciamento de hospedagem na web (ambientes Linux e Windows).
  • Sólido conhecimento de tecnologias de hospedagem na web, incluindo Apache, Nginx, IIS, MySQL/MariaDB e PHP.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de painel de controle, como cPanel, Plesk ou DirectAdmin.
  • Compreensão de DNS, certificados SSL e configurações de servidor de e-mail (por exemplo, SMTP, IMAP, POP3).
  • Experiência com práticas de segurança, incluindo firewalls, detecção de malware e prevenção de intrusão.
  • Capacidade de solucionar problemas e resolver problemas de hospedagem rapidamente sob pressão.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa, conforme necessário.
  • Disponibilidade para suporte de plantão durante a noite e fins de semana.


*Qualificações preferenciais:*


  • Certificações como RHCE, MCSE ou equivalente são um plus.
  • Experiência com plataformas de hospedagem em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud) é vantajosa.
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de script como Bash, Python ou PowerShell para automação.
  • Ter inglês intermediário/avançado em escrita, tradução e fala.



*Remuneração:*


Esta é uma posição freelance. A remuneração será baseada no escopo do projeto.


*Como se candidatar:*

Envie seu currículo, certificações relevantes e uma breve visão geral de sua experiência em administração de servidores e hospedagem na web para


Estamos ansiosos para ouvir de você!
